item.title: SARA: SLO-Aware Resource Allocation for Disaggregated Agentic LLM Services
item.description:
SARA tackles the challenge of efficiently allocating cloud resources for long‑context LLM inference by using service‑level objectives (SLOs) to guide the distribution of compute across disaggregated systems. The authors built a framework that automatically adjusts resource allocation based on real‑time SLO monitoring, and they demonstrated a measurable reduction in cost while meeting latency targets.

IT Breakdown: If you manage cloud infrastructure for LLM services, here is what to do: 1) deploy SARA to collect SLO metrics and current resource utilisation, 2) use its optimisation module to redistribute GPU/CPU time across your disaggregated nodes, 3) monitor the resulting latency and cost impact to validate the model’s effectiveness.

item.title: Flash-dLLM: IO-Aware KV Caching and Parallel Decoding for Fast, Memory-Efficient Diffusion LLMs
item.description:
Flash‑dLLM tackles slow, memory‑hungry inference in diffusion‑based LLMs by adding I/O‑aware KV caching and parallel decoding, achieving up to 2‑3× faster token generation while cutting memory usage.

IT Breakdown: If you manage inference workloads for diffusion LLMs, implement Flash‑dLLM’s I/O‑aware KV cache to reduce disk/SSD traffic and enable their parallel decoding engine to cut GPU utilisation, then monitor latency and cost savings.

item.title: Toolcompass: Guiding Tool Trialing, Not Suppressing It
item.description:
ToolCompass helps large‑language‑model agents decide when to try new tools, reducing wasted trials while still exploring unfamiliar tools. It builds a post‑training framework that groups tool calls by function and guides agents to choose trials that are likely useful. The result is fewer unnecessary calls and better use of interaction budgets. This is relevant for any organisation deploying LLM‑powered tools.

IT Breakdown: If you manage cloud infrastructure that uses LLM agents to trigger scripts or services, here is what to do: 1) integrate ToolCompass into your agent pipeline to map tool calls by function; 2) configure the guidance thresholds to match your interaction budget; 3) monitor trial counts and adjust to keep trials focused on high‑value functions.

item.title: [News] GigaPath-Flash and GigaTIME-Flash: Toward population-scale discovery with efficient pathology foundation models
item.description: Microsoft Research has released GigaPath-Flash and GigaTIME-Flash, two efficient pathology foundation models that reduce computational requirements while preserving performance. These models enable larger-scale studies and broader exploration in medical imaging without demanding high-end hardware.

item.title: [News] Advancing Private AI Compute with secure, server-side memory
item.description: Google DeepMind has launched private, server‑side memory for its Private AI Compute offering, enabling personal AI workloads to retain context without exposing data to the cloud. This new feature expands the scope of on‑prem AI by keeping model state on secure hardware, reducing latency and enhancing privacy.

item.title: [News] OpenAI extends cyber access to Ukraine for civilian defense
item.description: OpenAI has extended its Daybreak program, an AI-powered cyber defense tool, to support the Government of Ukraine’s civilian infrastructure protection efforts. The move underscores the growing role of AI in national security and highlights potential applications for enterprise cybersecurity teams.

item.title: [News] Gemini 3.8 text-to-speech says hello
item.description: Google DeepMind has announced Gemini 3.8, a new text‑to‑speech model that demonstrates improved naturalness and contextual understanding. The release builds on the Gemini series, offering higher fidelity speech synthesis suitable for integration into applications.

item.title: [News] ChatGPT mobile app gets voice-based agentic features
item.description: ChatGPT’s mobile app has been updated to include a voice-based agentic Work tab, allowing Pro and Plus users to perform tasks via voice commands on their phones.
